body: Your apps stay locked until you finish reading. {{session_length}} is enough to start. No streaks, no counters, no notification telling you that you slipped. Just a door that opens once you have read.
caption: Focus Lock holds {{app_category}} closed until your reading session is done. Pray. Read. Then unlock.
cta: Tilawah Lock — quiet structure for your phone.

slots.name: session_length
slots.description: A short, low-pressure duration phrase. Must not imply a required amount. Good: 'Two minutes'. Bad: 'Ten pages a day'.

slots.name: app_category
slots.description: A neutral app category, named generically. Good: 'social apps'. Never name a competitor or a specific product.
